title: Client deposit upload (BOW front end, DEPOSIT_UPLOAD / BOW_FUND)
when: BOD, 08:13; again in the morning for changed clients
purpose: Each client's funds (user deposit) for BOW (BOLTPlusOnWeb, BSE's front end from MarketPlace Tech), uploaded in the BOW Admin terminal. Comma-separated, no header, CRLF, 21 fields (the broker's file stops at 20, without Product). Because the deposit has a Category, the file separates equity and commodity money: by default Ledgerline writes TWO lines per client, category securities with the client's Securities and category commodities with the Commodities (exchange and market blank: every exchange of that category), as the BOW limits API computes them, so commodity money never raises the equity limit. Connections → BOW upload files can add a user-level line (category blank, their sum) or write the single combined user-level line of the old back office (category blank, Securities + Commodities). Whole rupees, debits kept (negative), a blocked, inactive or not active client 0. Ledgerline writes every active client (and 0 once for a client no longer active who was last sent a non-zero figure), or only the clients whose figures changed since the last file (the broker's second, small morning file). BOW takes user deposit and user stock files during market hours too (other files 17:30 to 08:00).

columns.name: Client ID
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The client's UCC (BOW's back-office ID), not the BOW login (CLIENT-T…)

columns.name: Filler
columns.note: Should be blank

columns.name: Exchange
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. BSE, NSE, MCX or NCDEX; blank = every exchange (the broker's file and BOW's own sample leave it blank). Ledgerline: blank

columns.name: Market
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. EQ, FO, CUR …; blank = every market. Ledgerline: blank

columns.name: Total Deposit
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The deposit in whole rupees (not × 10,000 as the API takes it); may be negative (a debit). Ledgerline: Securities (equity money) on the securities line, Commodities on the commodities line, their sum on a user-level line; rounded down to the rupee; 0 for a blocked, inactive or not active client

columns.note: Bit flags: 1 add the adhoc amount, 2 the manual collateral, 4 the other deposits into the effective deposit (3, 5, 6, 7 combinations; 0 none). Ledgerline: 1 (as the broker's file)

columns.note: Mark-to-market factor (multiplier). Ledgerline: 1 (as the broker's file)

columns.note: Effective amount. Ledgerline: 0 (as the broker's file)

columns.name: Add Adhoc/ManualColletra/Other Deposits into MTM Limit
columns.note: Bit flags as field 16, into the MTM limit. Ledgerline: 1 (as the broker's file)

columns.name: Add entry flag
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Y add the entry, N not. Ledgerline: Y

columns.name: Product
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Delivery, Intraday …; the broker's file has no such field (its lines stop at 20 fields) and BOW takes them. Ledgerline: left out (20 fields) unless Product is set in Connections → BOW upload files
